Thanks for all your work on it thus far yep, my covid test came negative, but I still needed (and wanted) to stay quarantined in St. Petersburg for 14 days just in case any symptoms appear the last thing I wanted is to bring the virus to my family so everything is fine, and I hopefully will be at my temp office in Krasnodar on Wednesday already 😄 and I'll go with your suggestion: will merge the doc in the current state and will add a ton of issues to make the changes more visible Hey, <@!420501213327392770> has a question about sparse merkle trees suitable for eth1-like state. <@456226577798135808> or <@!520564582196969472> can you help? <a:cketh:595706272658227251>
